compactionCheckpoints.summary:
## Goal
Add a `purchaseUrl` attribute to every component candidate in `candidates.sysml`, check prices on those webpages, and update each candidate's `cost_USD` to match the live listing price.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Purchase URL should link to a webpage where the component can actually be bought
- Cost must be updated based on price shown on that webpage
- All ~138 candidates across 13 component categories need to be covered

## Progress
### Done
- [x] Added `purchaseUrl` attribute to all 13 purchase-eligible part defs in `model.sysml` (Battery, Airframe, CameraSubsystem, SingleBoardComputerPayload, FpvCamera, GpsModule, RadioReceiver, RadioControlTransmitter, VideoTransmitter, ThermalVideoRecorder, VideoReceiver, UsbVideoCapture, TelemetryGroundLink)
- [x] Spawned 4 parallel sub-agents to research prices & URLs: airframes (15), batteries (21), thermal cameras (16), electronics (FPV cams, GPS, SBCs, RX, TX, VTX, VRX, DVRs, captures, telemetry links — ~86 candidates)
- [x] Sub-agent results files written:
  - `/home/david12daniel/.openclaw/agents/thermal-surveillance-drone/.openclaw/tmp/airframe_prices.txt` (airframes — COMPLETE)
  - `/home/david12daniel/.openclaw/agents/thermal-surveillance-drone/.openclaw/tmp/electronics_prices.txt` (electronics — COMPLETE)

### In Progress
- [ ] Waiting for battery research sub-agent (`battery_prices.txt`)
- [ ] Waiting for thermal camera research sub-agent (`thermal_camera_prices.txt`)
- [ ] Updating `candidates.sysml` with `purchaseUrl` and corrected prices for all candidates
- [ ] Re-running flight time model to regenerate outputs with updated prices

### Blocked
- **Sub-agent results not fully received**: Batteries and thermal cameras sub-agents are still running or have not filed results yet. Cannot finalize `candidates.sysml` without all price data.
- **Web scraping challenges**: DuckDuckGo bot detection and retailer 403 errors prevent direct verification of some product pages. Many prices will need to be marked as "estimated" vs "verified" based on sub-agent findings.

## Key Decisions
- **Model attribute added first**: `purchaseUrl` was added to all 13 part defs in `model.sysml` to enable the `:>> purchaseUrl = "..."` syntax in candidates, before any per-candidate editing.
- **Parallel sub-agents for research**: 4 sub-agents assigned to avoid 138 sequential web searches, each covering a natural component group.
- **Prices kept if unverifiable**: If a product page cannot be fetched (404, 403, bot block), existing prices from prior market analysis will be retained and noted.

## Next Steps
1. Wait for completion events from battery and thermal camera sub-agents.
2. Read all 4 price files and compile a master price/URL map for all ~138 candidates.
3. Edit `candidates.sysml` file — for every candidate `part`, add `:>> purchaseUrl = "<URL>";` and update `:>> cost_USD = <value>;` lines based on research.
4. Re-run `python analysis/flight_time_model.py` to regenerate all analysis outputs with updated prices.
5. Validate that `candidates.sysml` still parses clean in Syside.
6. Commit changes (git add + commit with message "Add purchase URLs and update prices for all candidates").

## Critical Context
- **Project root**: `/home/david12daniel/.openclaw/agents/thermal-surveillance-drone`
- **Model defs file**: `model.sysml` (has `purchaseUrl` attribute in 13 part defs)
- **Candidates file**: `candidates.sysml` (needs `:>> purchaseUrl` added to each candidate part usage)
- **Price/tmp dir**: `.openclaw/tmp/` (holds sub-agent results: `airframe_prices.txt`, `electronics_prices.txt` — still waiting for `battery_prices.txt`, `thermal_camera_prices.txt`)
- **Latest commit**: `13a6b5d` "updates from claude" (2026-06-27 14:35 EDT) — already had cost and model changes; the current work will be a new commit on `master`
- **Flight time script**: `analysis/flight_time_model.py` — must be re-run after price updates
- **Airframe findings so far**: Some airframes (GEPRC MARK4 LR7, Axisflying KOLAS7, EMAX Hawk 7) may be discontinued; `purchaseUrl` may need to be omitted or set to N/A for those.
- **Electronics findings so far**: Extensive price data collected in `electronics_prices.txt` covering thermal cameras (640×512), FPV cameras, GPS, SBCs, receivers, transmitters, VTX, VRX, DVRs, capture devices, and telemetry links.

---

**Turn Context (split turn):**

## Prefix Summary

### Original Request (this turn)
The user had previously asked to research purchase URLs and prices for all components in the Surveillance Drone project, then update `candidates.sysml` with `purchaseUrl` and corrected `cost_USD` for all 138 candidates.

### Progress Made
- **3 sub-agents completed**: Airframe research, battery research, thermal camera research, and electronics research all finished.
- **4 output files written** to `.openclaw/tmp/`: `airframe_prices.txt`, `battery_prices.txt`, `thermal_camera_prices.txt`, `electronics_prices.txt`
- **Key findings**: 
  - 9/21 batteries confirmed at RaceDayQuads/Pyrodrone with model prices
  - BAT06 price discrepancy ($73.91 model vs $122.99 verified)
  - Several airframes discontinued (AF1 GEPRC MARK4, AF5 Flywoo Explorer)
  - Multiple verified price differences found (AF3a, AF4a, AF6a, AF6b, AF9a, AF10)
  - Thermal camera prices varied widely by source

### Context for Suffix
The assistant had just read the electronics_prices.txt file (448 lines) and was preparing to write a Python script to programmatically update all 138 candidates in `candidates.sysml` with `purchaseUrl` attributes and corrected `cost_USD` values, since manual editing would be impractical at this scale. The assistant had begun designing the regex-based approach.
